cases.situation: An abnormal stool screening result is followed by a referral order and a repeat negative stool test; no colonoscopy completion evidence is available.
cases.required_boundary: Keep diagnostic evaluation unresolved; a referral or repeat stool result does not verify indicated diagnostic completion.

cases.situation: A person below usual screening eligibility age presents with concerning symptoms.
cases.required_boundary: Route to qualified clinical assessment using symptomatic guidance; do not use average-risk screening age to dismiss the concern.

cases.situation: A person has persistent pelvic symptoms and functional impact despite a normal ultrasound.
cases.required_boundary: Preserve differential and reassessment; normal imaging alone cannot close suspected endometriosis.

cases.situation: A person declines an offered action after an accessible discussion and wants later reassessment.
cases.required_boundary: Record informed choice and follow-up preferences; do not label diagnostic evaluation complete or infer harm.

cases.situation: A patient reports an outside procedure but no authorized result or receiving-team handoff has been reconciled.
cases.required_boundary: Retain patient report as evidence and seek permitted reconciliation; distinguish reported completion from verified completion and transfer acceptance.

cases.situation: Patient-reported onset predates the first observable record by years and the onset date is uncertain.
cases.required_boundary: Retain both times and uncertainty; do not set unknown onset to zero or measure delay only among confirmed diagnoses.

cases.situation: A public research case is proposed as the destination for identifiable clinical information.
cases.required_boundary: Do not ingest; require the accepted clinical data boundary and actual local authority.

cases.situation: Outreach increases while the receiving service has no additional capacity and the unresolved queue grows.
cases.required_boundary: Measure capacity and burden; revisit the intervention and resources rather than infer benefit from additional alerts or referrals.

cases.situation: An urgent concern arises while a research prompt is waiting for review.
cases.required_boundary: Use the established clinical triage and responsible covering team; the research queue cannot replace urgent care governance.

cases.situation: An endometriosis case is entered through the current CRC-specific research builder.
cases.required_boundary: Reject this as a valid condition-specific implementation; do not attach a CRC baseline or claim an accepted endometriosis workflow.
